svg.title: FSR × TSR traceability matrix
svg.text: 58 FSRs (rows, by safety goal) × 128 TSRs (columns, by WP-S-02 block) · a cell is a parent link (WP-S-02 §12.1), coloured by the TSR's status
Status from each requirement's Impl column by the rule of WP-S-03 Figure 6-1 (a qualified “Implemented” counts as partly). Nothing is verified on hardware yet, so implemented is blue, never green.
Row dot: the FSR's own status. “by ref.”: the FSR applies the TSRs of the FSRs it names. Bottom row: TSRs whose parent is a goal or another requirement, not an FSR (outlined).
